checks: Conversation captions appear as soon as the model replies, independently of Qwen audio preparation.
Existing Qwen voice plays the authored greeting and an actual generated conversation response through the website backend.
A new question interrupts the previous clip; route navigation stops playback and revokes its object URL.
Guided narration uses actual Qwen WAV playback; Pause/Resume and Exit immediately release audio, requests and blob URLs without browser speech.
Exit during an intentionally delayed speech request cancels it; no late clip or emergency speech begins.
An explicitly simulated Qwen outage activates the labeled emergency browser fallback and keeps captions; Exit cancels that fallback.
Page-hide cleanup stops active Qwen audio and revokes URLs; the browser page then closes cleanly.
method: Actual Qwen audio decoded and played. Browser emergency speech is instrumented; outage and pending-request cancellation are explicitly simulated.
